phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Telling what happened
goal: Tell about a past event and ask for news.

variants.study: Ieri ho lavorato tutto il giorno.
variants.phon: YEH-ree oh lah-voh-RAH-toh TOOT-toh eel JOR-noh

model.note: A woman says "Sono andata" (ahn-DAH-tah): with "essere", the past participle agrees with the subject.

variants.study: Sono andato a trovare mia nonna.
variants.phon: SOH-noh ahn-DAH-toh ah troh-VAH-reh MEE-ah NOHN-nah
variants.native: I went to see my grandmother.

variants.study: La settimana scorsa ho visitato Firenze.
variants.phon: lah seht-tee-MAH-nah SKOR-sah oh vee-zee-TAH-toh fee-REHN-tseh

variants.study: Due giorni fa ho visitato Firenze.
variants.phon: DOO-eh JOR-nee fah oh vee-zee-TAH-toh fee-REHN-tseh
variants.native: Two days ago I visited Florence.

variants.study: Lo scorso fine settimana ho visitato Firenze.
variants.phon: loh SKOR-soh FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah oh vee-zee-TAH-toh fee-REHN-tseh

model.note: For "I'm tired", Italian uses "Sono stanco / stanca" (with essere, not stare).
Short reactions to learn as they are.

variants.study: Prima abbiamo cenato, poi siamo usciti.
variants.phon: PREE-mah ahb-BYAH-moh cheh-NAH-toh, POY SYAH-moh oo-SHEE-tee
variants.native: First we had dinner, then we went out.

variants.study: Prima ho fatto la doccia, poi siamo usciti.
variants.phon: PREE-mah oh FAHT-toh lah DOHT-chah, POY SYAH-moh oo-SHEE-tee
variants.native: First I took a shower, then we went out.

variants.study: Prima abbiamo bevuto un caffè, poi siamo usciti.
variants.phon: PREE-mah ahb-BYAH-moh beh-VOO-toh oon kahf-FEH, POY SYAH-moh oo-SHEE-tee
variants.native: First we had a coffee, then we went out.

variants.study: Prima ho finito il lavoro, poi siamo usciti.
variants.phon: PREE-mah oh fee-NEE-toh eel lah-VOH-roh, POY SYAH-moh oo-SHEE-tee
variants.native: First I finished work, then we went out.
Afterwards we went for a walk.

model.note: The participle agrees: "Com'è andato il viaggio?" (koh-MEH ahn-DAH-toh) with a masculine noun.

variants.study: Hai passato un buon fine settimana?
variants.phon: AH-ee pahs-SAH-toh oon bwohn FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah
variants.native: Did you have a good weekend?

variants.study: In vacanza abbiamo visitato molti musei.
variants.phon: een vah-KAHN-tsah ahb-BYAH-moh vee-zee-TAH-toh MOHL-tee moo-ZEH-ee
variants.native: On holiday we visited lots of museums.
On holiday we ate really well.

variants.study: In vacanza abbiamo fatto il bagno ogni giorno.
variants.phon: een vah-KAHN-tsah ahb-BYAH-moh FAHT-toh eel BAH-nyoh OH-nyee JOR-noh
variants.native: On holiday we went swimming every day.

variants.study: In vacanza abbiamo preso il sole.
variants.phon: een vah-KAHN-tsah ahb-BYAH-moh PREH-zoh eel SOH-leh

variants.study: È stato un bel fine settimana.
variants.phon: eh STAH-toh oon behl FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Ciao Marta! Come stai?
turns.phon: CHAH-oh MAR-tah. KOH-meh STAH-ee
turns.native: Hi Marta! How are you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bene, grazie! E tu? Novità?
turns.phon: BEH-neh, GRAH-tsyeh. eh TOO. noh-vee-TAH
turns.native: Fine, thanks! And you? Any news?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sì! La settimana scorsa sono andato a Napoli.
turns.phon: SEE. lah seht-tee-MAH-nah SKOR-sah SOH-noh ahn-DAH-toh ah NAH-poh-lee
turns.native: Yes! Last week I went to Naples.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Davvero? Com'è andata?
turns.phon: dahv-VEH-roh. koh-MEH ahn-DAH-tah
turns.native: Really? How was it?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Benissimo! Abbiamo mangiato la vera pizza.
turns.phon: beh-NEES-see-moh. ahb-BYAH-moh mahn-JAH-toh lah VEH-rah PEET-tsah
turns.native: Great! We ate real pizza.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Che bello! Io invece ho lavorato tutto il fine settimana.
turns.phon: keh BEHL-loh. EE-oh een-VEH-cheh oh lah-voh-RAH-toh TOOT-toh eel FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah
turns.native: How nice! I, on the other hand, worked all weekend.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Peccato! Ti va un caffè? Ti racconto tutto.
turns.phon: pehk-KAH-toh. tee vah oon kahf-FEH. tee rahk-KOHN-toh TOOT-toh
turns.native: What a shame! Do you feel like a coffee? I'll tell you everything.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Volentieri!
turns.phon: voh-lehn-TYEH-ree
turns.native: I'd love to!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno! Hai passato un buon fine settimana?
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh. AH-ee pahs-SAH-toh oon bwohn FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah
turns.native: Morning! Did you have a good weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì, sabato siamo andati al mare. E tu?
turns.phon: SEE, SAH-bah-toh SYAH-moh ahn-DAH-tee ahl MAH-reh. eh TOO
turns.native: Yes, on Saturday we went to the seaside. And you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Io sono rimasto a casa, ho dormito molto.
turns.phon: EE-oh SOH-noh ree-MAHS-toh ah KAH-zah, oh dor-MEE-toh MOHL-toh
turns.native: I stayed at home, I slept a lot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Hai visto la partita ieri sera?
turns.phon: AH-ee VEES-toh lah par-TEE-tah YEH-ree SEH-rah
turns.native: Did you see the match last night?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: No, non ho avuto tempo. Com'è finita?
turns.phon: noh, nohn oh ah-VOO-toh TEHM-poh. koh-MEH fee-NEE-tah
turns.native: No, I didn't have time. How did it end?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Due a uno. È stata una bella partita.
turns.phon: DOO-eh ah OO-noh. eh STAH-tah OO-nah BEHL-lah par-TEE-tah
turns.native: Two–one. It was a good match.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Peccato! E la riunione di venerdì com'è andata?
turns.phon: pehk-KAH-toh. eh lah ryoo-NYOH-neh dee veh-nehr-DEE koh-MEH ahn-DAH-tah
turns.native: Shame! And how did Friday's meeting go?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bene, ma è stata lunga. Prima abbiamo parlato del budget, poi del nuovo progetto.
turns.phon: BEH-neh, mah eh STAH-tah LOON-gah. PREE-mah ahb-BYAH-moh par-LAH-toh dehl BAHD-jeht, POY dehl NWOH-voh proh-JEHT-toh
turns.native: Fine, but it was long. First we talked about the budget, then about the new project.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

dialogues.situation: On the phone with your mother (tu)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Pronto, mamma? Come stai?
turns.phon: PROHN-toh, MAHM-mah. KOH-meh STAH-ee
turns.native: Hello, Mum? How are you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Ciao tesoro! Sto bene. E tu? Dove sei?
turns.phon: CHAH-oh teh-ZOH-roh. stoh BEH-neh. eh TOO. DOH-veh SEH-ee
turns.native: Hi sweetheart! I'm fine. And you? Where are you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sono a Firenze. Ieri ho visitato il Duomo.
turns.phon: SOH-noh ah fee-REHN-tseh. YEH-ree oh vee-zee-TAH-toh eel DWOH-moh
turns.native: I'm in Florence. Yesterday I visited the Duomo.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Che bello! E con chi sei?
turns.phon: keh BEHL-loh. eh kohn KEE SEH-ee
turns.native: How nice! And who are you with?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Con Luca. Due giorni fa siamo arrivati in treno.
turns.phon: kohn LOO-kah. DOO-eh JOR-nee fah SYAH-moh ar-ree-VAH-tee een TREH-noh
turns.native: With Luca. We arrived by train two days ago.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Avete mangiato bene?
turns.phon: ah-VEH-teh mahn-JAH-toh BEH-neh
turns.native: Did you eat well?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sì, benissimo! Dopo ti mando le foto.
turns.phon: SEE, beh-NEES-see-moh. DOH-poh tee MAHN-doh leh FOH-toh
turns.native: Yes, really well! I'll send you the photos later.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bravo. Salutami Luca!
turns.phon: BRAH-voh. sah-LOO-tah-mee LOO-kah
turns.native: Good. Say hi to Luca for me!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Tell what you did in the recent past, place it in time, sequence actions (prima, poi, dopo), ask for news and react (che bello, peccato, davvero).
